en_title: Assassin's Creed Maker Ubisoft Confirms Further Layoffs, With 166 Jobs Lost From 2 Major Studios
cn_title: 《刺客信条》开发商育碧确认进一步裁员，两家主要工作室共失去166个职位
opus_summary: 育碧宣布新一轮重组，在蒙特利尔和魁北克市的业务中削减166个职位。公司称，随着产品阵容演变，制作需求也在变化。IGN了解到，裁员涉及项目被取消或调整方向的员工，以及因在研项目减少而无法转岗的员工。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft has announced another round of restructuring that eliminates 166 more jobs.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧宣布新一轮重组，将再裁撤166个职位。

paragraphs.en: In a surprising move, these positions are being lost from two of Ubisoft's most prominent studios: its enormous development hub in Montreal, which has led development on numerous Assassin's Creed and Far Cry blockbusters, and its sister studio in Quebec, which most recently launched last year's Assassin's Creed Shadows.
paragraphs.cn: 令人意外的是，这些职位来自育碧旗下两家最重要的工作室：其位于蒙特利尔的大型开发中心，以及位于魁北克的姊妹工作室。前者曾主导开发众多《刺客信条》和《孤岛惊魂》系列大作，后者最近推出的作品则是去年的《刺客信条：影》。

paragraphs.en: In a statement sent to IGN, Ubisoft blamed the job losses on an evolving portfolio and changing prodution needs, without specifying which franchises the impacted team members had been working on, or if any projects were no longer moving forward.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧在发给IGN的一份声明中，将此次裁员归因于产品组合的演变和制作需求的变化，但没有具体说明受影响的团队成员此前参与了哪些系列的开发，也没有说明是否有项目不再推进。

paragraphs.en: However, IGN understands that the layoffs affect employees whose projects have been cancelled or refocused, as well as those who could not be reassigned due to the decrease in the number of active projects.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，据IGN了解，此次裁员影响到所参与项目被取消或调整方向的员工，以及因正在进行的项目数量减少而无法被重新安排的员工。

paragraphs.en: "Ubisoft is reducing its workforce by 166 positions across its Montréal and Québec City operations," a Ubisoft spokesperson told IGN. "As our portfolio evolves, our production needs are changing, requiring us to adjust the size of some teams to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧发言人告诉IGN：「育碧正在蒙特利尔和魁北克市的业务中裁减166个职位。随着我们的产品组合不断演变，我们的制作需求也在发生变化，这要求我们调整部分团队的规模，以确保资源与当前的制作重点和业务需求保持一致。

paragraphs.en: "We deeply value the contributions of these teams and recognise the impact this may have on our colleagues. We are committed to supporting them through this process with care and respect. Those affected are being provided with severance, extended health care benefits, career transition services and other resources."
paragraphs.cn: 「我们非常重视这些团队的贡献，也认识到这可能给我们的同事带来的影响。我们致力于在这一过程中以关怀和尊重的态度为他们提供支持。受影响的员工将获得遣散费、延长的医疗福利、职业转型服务及其他资源。」

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft Montreal is currently deep in development on Assassin's Creed Hexe , the long-awaited new blockbuster entry in the historical stabathon series that's due to be set during the Witch Trials in Europe. Despite being announced years ago, there's still no word on when Hexe will actually launch. Earlier this year, the game lost its creative director Clint Hocking as part of a shake-up of leadership for the Assassin's Creed brand.
paragraphs.cn: 育碧蒙特利尔目前正深入开发《Assassin's Creed Hexe》，这是这个历史题材刺杀系列备受期待的新一部大作，预计将以欧洲猎巫审判时期为背景。尽管该作多年前就已公布，但实际发售时间仍没有消息。今年早些时候，作为《刺客信条》品牌领导层调整的一部分，该作创意总监Clint Hocking离职。

paragraphs.en: As for Ubisoft Quebec, while no further expansion plans for Assassin's Creed Shadows were announced for this year, fans were surprised to see its post-launch content curtailed so quickly compared to previous blockbusters. While Shadows sold well at launch, it's believed that the game failed to maintain this momentum, despite its feudal Japan setting being long-awaited by the franchise's community. As of now, it's unclear what else the studio is working on, or how today's changes will impact it in future.
paragraphs.cn: 至于育碧魁北克，虽然今年没有公布《刺客信条：影》的进一步扩展计划，但粉丝们惊讶地发现，与此前的大作相比，该作的发售后内容如此迅速地被削减。尽管《刺客信条：影》发售时销量不错，但据信该作未能保持这一势头，尽管其日本封建时代的背景是该系列社区期待已久的。截至目前，尚不清楚该工作室还在开发什么，也不清楚今天的变动将来会对其产生什么影响。
